title: The Salar de Uyuni and lithium: a salt flat with a future
goal: Describe the Salar de Uyuni and the debate over lithium, using hedges to say what is certain and what is not.

items: I can soften a claim about lithium with *parece que*, *según parece* and *podría decirse que*.
I can say what the Salar de Uyuni is and how it was formed.
I can say what the government says about lithium contracts, with the date.
